settings.heading: Returns & Exchanges
settings.intro: We want you to feel confident every time you order from us. If something isn’t quite right — whether it’s not what you expected or simply not for you — we’re here to make it easy. Here’s everything you need to know about returns, exchanges, and refunds.
settings.closing_text: Have a question that isn’t covered here? We’re always happy to help.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer:
We offer a [CONFIRM: 14]-day returns window, starting from the day your order is delivered. If something isn’t right, you’re welcome to send it back for a full refund of the item price.

Items must be unworn, undamaged, and returned in their original Daphne Blue packaging. We ask that jewellery is tried on gently and not worn out before deciding — this helps us ensure every piece reaches the next person in perfect condition.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer:
Simply email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk with your order number and the item(s) you’d like to return. We’ll confirm everything and send you a return address along with any instructions.

Please don’t send items back without letting us know first — it helps us keep track of everything and process your refund as quickly as possible.

settings.question: How long do I have to return an item?
settings.answer:
You have [CONFIRM: 14] days from the date of delivery to let us know you’d like to make a return. Once you’ve been in touch, we ask that the item is posted back within [CONFIRM: 7] working days.

If your return falls just outside this window, please get in touch anyway — we’ll always do our best to help.

settings.question: What condition must items be in?
settings.answer:
To be eligible for a return, items should be:

• Unworn and in their original condition
• Free from perfume, makeup, or any signs of wear
• Returned in the original Daphne Blue packaging (pouch and box)

We understand you may want to try a piece on to see how it looks — that’s absolutely fine. We simply ask that it’s handled with care, as you’d expect from a brand-new piece of jewellery.

settings.question: Who pays for return shipping?
settings.answer:
[CONFIRM: Return postage is the responsibility of the customer. We recommend using a tracked and insured service, as we’re unable to accept responsibility for items that are lost or damaged in transit on their way back to us.]

[CONFIRM: If your item arrived damaged or faulty, we’ll cover the return postage in full — just get in touch and we’ll arrange everything.]

settings.question: Can I return sale or discounted items?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: Yes — sale items can be returned within the same 14-day window and under the same conditions as full-price purchases. Your refund will reflect the price you paid at the time of purchase.]

settings.question: Can I return more than one item from the same order?
settings.answer: Of course. If you’d like to return multiple items, just let us know all the pieces you’d like to send back when you email us. You can include them in a single parcel — no need to post them separately.

settings.question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or style?
settings.answer:
[CONFIRM: We don’t currently offer direct exchanges. If you’d like a different size or style, the simplest route is to return your original item for a refund and place a new order for the piece you’d prefer.]

This way, there’s no delay — your new piece will be on its way to you as soon as you order, rather than waiting for us to receive and process the return first.

settings.question: What if the item I want is out of stock?
settings.answer: If the piece you had in mind is temporarily unavailable, you’re welcome to return your original item for a refund in the meantime. You can also email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk to ask about restocks — we’re happy to let you know if and when a piece is expected back.

settings.question: How long will my refund take?
settings.answer:
Once we’ve received your return and confirmed that everything is in order, we’ll process your refund within [CONFIRM: 3–5] working days. The refund will be issued to the original payment method used at checkout.

Please allow a few additional days for the funds to appear in your account — this varies depending on your bank or card provider.

settings.question: How will I receive my refund?
settings.answer:
Refunds are always returned to the original payment method. If you paid by card, the refund will go back to that card. If you used Apple Pay, Google Pay, or Shop Pay, it will be returned through the same route.

We’ll send you a confirmation email as soon as your refund has been processed on our end.

settings.question: Will I be refunded for the original shipping cost?
settings.answer: [CONFIRM: If you paid for shipping on your original order, that cost is non-refundable unless the item arrived damaged, faulty, or incorrect. In those cases, we’ll refund the full order total including any delivery charges.]

settings.question: Can I get a partial refund?
settings.answer:
If you’re returning some items from a multi-item order, we’ll refund the value of the returned pieces. The rest of your order remains unaffected.

[CONFIRM: Please note that if your original order qualified for free shipping based on a minimum spend, returning items that bring the total below that threshold will not affect your refund — the shipping discount still applies.]

settings.question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged?
settings.answer:
We’re truly sorry if anything arrives less than perfect. Please email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk as soon as possible with:

• Your order number
• A brief description of the issue
• One or two photos showing the damage

We’ll get back to you promptly and arrange a replacement or full refund — whichever you’d prefer.

settings.question: What counts as a faulty item?
settings.answer:
A faulty item is one that has a manufacturing defect or doesn’t match the product description — for example, a broken clasp on arrival, a missing stone, or visible damage that wasn’t described. Normal variations in handcrafted pieces (very slight differences in texture or tone) are part of what makes each piece unique and are not considered faults.

If you’re unsure, send us a photo and we’ll take a look — no obligation.

settings.question: I received the wrong item — what should I do?
settings.answer: We’re sorry about that. Please email us at hello@daphneblue.co.uk with your order number and a photo of the item you received. We’ll arrange for the correct piece to be sent out to you and cover the return postage for the incorrect item.

settings.question: Do I need to pay return postage for a damaged or faulty item?
settings.answer: No. If your item arrived damaged, faulty, or incorrect, we’ll cover the return postage in full. We’ll arrange everything once you’ve been in touch — you won’t be out of pocket.
